name: Sensitive Nose (Dromite)
body:
–

Benefit: You gain a +1 trait bonus on your Perception or Survival checks related to smell. However, you also take a -1 penalty on saves that involve resisting smells, such as stench.

Special: Only Dromites may take select this Racial Trait
